sources.excerpt: Supa Tweak - **Builder:** Basic Audio - **Catalog type:** Fuzz - **Identity:** Expanded Supa MKI/Marshall Supa Fuzz-style fuzz with externally separated Gain and Bias, interstage low/gain cut and Sag switching. 1. Supa Tweak — Basic Audio: https://www.basicaudio.net/store-1/5einpey75gjgckjedkvplbfsb3vnya-y3hb9-97e3s-cnzrr-bfrf8 - **Archive parent:** Supa Tweak - **Builder:** Basic Audio - **Catalog type:** Fuzz - **Identity:* - **Archive parent:** Supa Tweak - **Builder:** Basic Audio - **Catalog type:** Fuzz - **Identity:** Expanded Supa MKI/Marshall Supa Fuzz-style fuzz with externally separated Gain and Bias, interstage low/gain cut and Sag switching. [1][2] - **GAIN:** Gain amount independent from the bias setting. - **BIAS:** Operating-point control. - **Interstage LOW/GAIN CUT:** Reduces the low-frequency/gain feed between stages and improves cleanup. - **SAG:** Adds more apparent gain and a voltage-droop response under harder attack. [1] - **Primary reference:** Basic Audio Supa MKI / Marshall Supa Fuzz MKI family. - The expanded controls are Basic Audio's own implementation. - Exact production transistor technology and device part numbers are not publicly documented. - Exact clipping-device type and part number are not publicly documented. - **9V center-negative** with battery support. [1] - No numbered electronic revision established. - Supa Tweak is treated as a distinct model because its Gain/Bias/Sag control architecture is materially different from the simpler Supa MKI. Basic Audio describes the interstage cut as improving cleanup and the Sag switch as adding gain plus a noticeable dip under strong picking. The result can move from open vintage fuzz toward softer, collapsing and compressed textures. [1][2] - **Identity:** High - **Supa MKI lineage:** High - **Gain/Bias separation:** High - **Sag behavior:** High - **Exact transistor:** Unknown - **Exact diode:** Unknown Basic Audio's Supa Tweak page was checked directly and compared with its Supa MKI reference. The evidence supports the control changes, Sag behavior and lineage while leaving unpublished semiconductor details unresolved. [1][2] 1.
